column1: # A name that is a measurement only under its section's heading -> a LOINC
# code. OUR judgement, Apache-2.0; the codes are LOINC's (LICENSE-3RD-PARTY).
# `HR`, `RV5` and `SV1` are real ECG measurements, and nothing in the alias
# index answers them (#281): each was stored as a series of its own, named
# only by its abbreviation. They are not added to resolver_overrides.tsv
# because the abbreviation alone does not say what was measured: `HR` on a
# lab page is not a heart rate anyone should guess. A row here is consulted
# only when the reading was printed under its panel's heading
# person's confirmed alias and before the lexical resolver.
# Matching is exact over standardize.fold.name_key: one row per spelling, no
# substring search. The right-hand side is a LOINC code, not an alias key,
# so there is no second hop for a row to miss. A spelling the resolver
# already answers right on its own (`PR间期`, `QT间期`, `QTc间期`, `QRS电轴`,
# `心率`) has no row: it codes the same whatever its heading.

column4: the code 心率 resolves to, so a report's two spellings are one series
the QRS duration; an axis prints as 电轴 or Axis
the QRS axis, which is what an ECG's unqualified axis is
not a bare P波: the resolver reads that as the atrial rate (8894-8)

column1: # Alone, `PRO` answered proline, `LEU` leucine, `KET` TP73L gene mutations,
# `NIT` urea nitrogen, `URO` free PSA and `BIL` kidney weight; they refuse
# there now (resolver_overrides.tsv), and `GLU` alone is a blood glucose,
# which it usually is. Each code is the one the Chinese name beside it
# resolves to (`尿蛋白`, `尿白细胞`, `尿酮体`, `尿亚硝酸盐`, `尿胆原`,
# `尿胆红素`, `尿糖`), so a report's two spellings are one series. A semi-quantitative value with a unit (`URO 3.2 µmol/L`) meets
# the unit gate as any other reading does.

column4: leukocyte esterase, the strip's pad; a microscopy count prints under 尿沉渣
